svg.title: Red Floor Panel
svg.desc: Interpretive study after an actually inspected primary reference. Geometry and standardized vivid screen colour approximate. Schematic silhouette of the actual photographed FLOOR PROJECTION. All four observed panel corners retained, floor and mounting shadows omitted. Plan outline and rectified aspect are not asserted; excluded from physical scaling.
svg.metadata: Primary reference: https://ellsworthkelly.org/work/red-floor-panel/; catalogue record ek-835; inspected2026-10-27. Pure editable vector study, not photographic facsimile.
